summary:
Shorter gates, and a notification when a run waits at one: the plan gate gives what will be done, in which files and with which risk in three lines, and each criterion with its planned test; un_state.py gate records that a run waits (plan, ship, delta, coverage below the minimum, a blocked ticket) and composes the ship gate from the run's files, so the orchestrator no longer reads them or types it out; a Notification hook raises a desktop notification naming the run and the gate after about a minute idle (
otify.gates turns it off); the questions that block a ticket come in one message.
